decisions.statement: Promote only the validated allowlisted eligible first payload candidate to scoped productivity within HNK-L03_BINAH_CONTROLLED_DIRECT_QUESTION_CLAUSE_PAYLOAD_ONLY.
Limit productive realizations to VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE only.
Preserve VALI FROZEN and PARAZAMI WATCH; productivity does not promote lexical authority.
Do not inherit STR001/STR002 rules or authorize arbitrary activity lexemes/clauses.
Preserve no subject/person, tense/aspect or copula inference and no KE generalization.
If approved, open only a separate curriculum-mapping strategy gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Productivity promotion is not curriculum mapping.
Productivity promotion does not author or validate OPI or unlock QA/STR003-STR005.
Productivity promotion does not activate runtime.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only scoped productivity promotion while this gate remains active.
